title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Four Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos to Carry Out the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Seventy-Eight

text.en: The sum of four hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury no otherwise appropriated, to carry out the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred seventy-eight. Thereafter, the necessary funds shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
